text: Kickoff day. Mexico open against South Africa as 71% favourites — the model's most likely score is 2–0. Home advantage is worth ~100 Elo points in our engine.
Pre-tournament baseline is locked: Spain 27.8% to win it all, almost double Argentina's 16.5%. The gap is mostly Elo — Spain enter 60 points clear of anyone.
Fun one from 100k sims: Norway's most likely R32 opponent is Germany (14.8%). A third-place finish in Group I probably routes through the toughest part of the bracket.
